method: Searched the web for each site (a fetch of the sites themselves fails from the builder's network), so features come from search results, vendor pages and third-party reviews; paid tiers and limits change often, confirm before any price claim.

features.name: Several boards
features.detail: Make as many boards as you need and switch between them; free plans cap the count.

features.detail: The stages a card moves through.
